review_locator: PMCID:PMC10754292, Understanding interleukin 11 as a disease gene and therapeutic target; PMCID:PMC10714194, Interleukin-11 and its eminent role in tissue fibrosis: a possible therapeutic target
primary_title: IL11 Stimulates IL33 Expression and Proinflammatory Fibroblast Activation across Tissues
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-11 induces IL33 expression across human kidney, lung and skin fibroblasts, and STAT3 inhibition prevents the IL33 response.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-11-associated IL33 gene-expression bridge; retain the STAT3-dependent fibroblast context and do not infer a universal IL-11 mechanism or direct IL-33 secretion from the gene edge.

primary_title: IL11 Stimulates IL33 Expression and Proinflammatory Fibroblast Activation across Tissues
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-11-associated CCL20 upregulation in primary human fibroblasts during the early transcriptional response and increased CCL20 in the fibroblast secretome.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-11-associated CCL20 gene-expression bridge; preserve the fibroblast time-course and transcript-versus-secreted-protein distinction.

decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-11-associated CXCL8/IL-8 induction in primary human fibroblasts during the inflammatory response and increased IL-8 in the secretome.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-11-associated CXCL8/IL-8 gene-expression bridge; preserve the fibroblast and time-course context without adding a downstream receptor claim.
